meals.note: Last Sundays before the joins: Loretta and Nydine (5/28), Ultand and Ninae (6/1). One short? Seat her at two tables.

gifts.note: Buy several on the Raivo Port trip
Nothing they like is buyable yet: meals carry them
Buy several on the Raivo Port trip

missables.text: Talk to Alexandra in City Streets, then catch her follow-up scene in Lowtown
detail: She is this chapter's boss; the plan recruits her on 6/1, Ch 8 week 1.

note.text: Master the Ch 6 Specialty classes; Zarcone takes [[class:Brigand]] at Lv 20 (Axe C, Sword C)
detail: Sirocco joins about Lv 15 as a Diviner: Beginner License only if he arrives in another class.
Loretta and Nydine join about Lv 15: Myrmidon and Armored Ornius Rider at Lv 20 (Ch 9).

assign.why: Transfer Battalions tutorial: every Tactics Manual goes to her
Cindered Road Cave copy: Dragoon needs Flying C
Legacy of a Legendary Sculptor reward
First Vandahl copy: Avo +5, Wt 3 on the Strike dodger

note.text: Do the Transfer Battalions tutorial: it pays a Tactics Manual for Theodora
detail: Then transfer every surplus roll at the Transport Chief: 100 troop points = 1 Tactics Manual for Theodora.
Keep the named squads plus 2 spare Novice Hunters and 1 spare Rookie Soldiers for the bench.

note.text: Blacksmith: repairs only until Renown 7. Bank the Enno Isle ores for the Ch 9 refines

recruits.action: Recruit him in week 1 with a copy of the Monument Verse and deploy him in slot 8: main nuke
detail: Not at Renown 5 by the Ch 7 battle? He deploys from Ch 8, and Bonaventure stays the main nuke one more map.
He arrives about 10 levels under the core: feed him kills so Shaman (Lv 20) and Ovate (Lv 35) land on time.
He joins at about Lv 15 in a Beginner class: Diviner exam only if he isn't one already.

recruits.action: Hand over 3 Iron Swords at Support 3 and Renown 5: Strike dodger from Ch 8
detail: About Lv 15 in a Beginner class (Hunter if it isn't hers): Myrmidon at Lv 20 (Ch 9), Sword C.
Support 3 not in by 5/28? Recruit her Ch 8 week 1. She supports Tobias and Ultand.
EXP: Ch 7 dungeon parties now; she deploys in slot 3 from Ch 8.

recruits.action: Hand over 3 Iron Axes at Support 3 and Renown 5: Part II bench cavalry
detail: About Lv 15: Armored Ornius Rider at Lv 20 (Ch 9); Cataphract at the Part II Lv 35 floor.
Keep her mounted: Barge Through works only on cavalry. She supports Bonaventure and Lilian.
EXP: dungeon parties and Arena seats; she never takes a Part I slot.

prep.text: Ultand and Ninae (Renown 6) land late Ch 7: recruit both on 6/1 (Ch 8 week 1) at Support 3
detail: Ultand: her short quest ?. Ninae: 1 Paradise Fish (Lake Brontes, Saveilon).
Both join at about Lv 15 and take Priest at Lv 20 (Ch 9).

prep.text: Buy 3 Iron Swords (Loretta) and 3 Iron Axes (Nydine) before their Support 3 lands
Gather Alexandra's [[item:Levin Sword]] mats now: she joins on 6/1 and bartering it is week 1
detail: Thry Fruit ×10 and Yuna Mei ×1 (Spare Turns rows below).

route.note: Gather 30 [[gather:Thry Fruit]]; 10 more for Alexandra's Levin Sword barter (Ch 8)

sub.note: Finish by 7/31: the [[item:Tempest Bow]] is Lysander's Archer bow (Ch 8 to 9)
Manuals: Heavy-Armor to Theodora, Flying to Alexandra (Ch 8), Riding to Nydine
detail: Flying D for Alexandra's Ch 9 Wing Soldier exam; Lysander takes the Cindered Road Cave copy.
Riding D for Nydine's Armored Ornius Rider exam (Ch 9).

explore.text: [[place:Cindered Road Cave]] (Lv 22): Flying Manual for Lysander, Conflagrant Gem for Tobias
detail: Also a Concoction.

explore.text: [[place:Cave Behind the Falls]] (Lv 22): [[item:Pure Water]] for Alexandra (Ch 9+), Bullion
detail: Archive B too: nobody reads it (see Archives).

explore.text: [[place:Masked Woods]] (Lv 15, Melias): [[item:Veroquine]], Heavy-Armor Manual, Venin Bow
detail: [[item:Veroquine]] is cursed (Curse 2): hold it to the end of Part I (Drifting Reliquary).
Melias is open by now (Ladon Lake gathering); no Theodora source names this chest.

explore.text: [[place:Cougar Woodlands]] (Lv 23): [[item:Muen]], a cursed spear, School Scandal, 2 Bullion
detail: Muen is cursed (Curse 2): hold it to the end of Part I (Drifting Reliquary).
Part III: Theodora's Underworld Calm loop (her build page).
Windstone crystals here too: bank it for Alexandra's Levin Sword (+1 Ch 9, +2 Ch 12).

explore.text: Enno Isle (Lv 24, Theodora only in Part I): Healing Staff for Sofia, Short Axe for Zarcone, Bullion
detail: Mine its crystals: Windstone, Cullet and Blue Snoll for the special refines.

explore.text: Recruit Soldiers at [[place:Raivo Port]]: clergy squads for Sofia, Bonaventure and the walls
detail: Renown 5: select the town again while the gauge runs (Rousing Speech); a good result strips low tiers.
[[battalion:Holy Disciples]]: Sofia at Authority C. [[battalion:Elevated Priests]]: Bonaventure at C (Ch 10).
[[battalion:Fighting Clergy]]: Ninae at Priest (Ch 9).

explore.text: Assign [[battalion:Mage Pupils]] to Sirocco the week he joins
detail: [[battalion:Blackfire Mages]] replace it once Mage weeks give him Authority D (Ch 8).

explore.group: Spare Turns: gather for Vandahl, nearest stop first
explore.text: Alexandra's [[item:Levin Sword]] (Ch 8 week 1): Thry Fruit ×10 and Yuna Mei ×1
detail: [[gather:Thry Fruit]] at [[place:Valeri Gorge]] (Amalthea), [[gather:Yuna Mei]] at [[place:Cape Damasen]] (Castalia).
Jester's copy (Ch 10) goes to Sirocco, so this barter is hers.

explore.group: Spare Turns: gather for Vandahl, nearest stop first
explore.text: Stockpile for Ch 8's Send Supplies: [[gather:Ladon Loach]] and Steelfish
detail: Ladon Loach: Enceladus Bridge, Ladon Lake, Oracle Falls. Steelfish: Socie Bay, Raivo Port.
Hold them in inventory: whether items gathered before a quest appears count is unknown.

explore.group: Spare Turns: gather for Vandahl, nearest stop first
explore.text: Loretta's [[item:Phantom Ring]]: Shaktoh ×3 and Soldanella ×3 (×6 each for Noctula's second copy ?)
detail: [[gather:Shaktoh]]: [[place:Forest of Enigmas]] (Braxithea). [[gather:Soldanella]]: [[place:Orion Canyon]] (Solidus).

explore.text: Run [[place:Valhalla Mine]] (Lv 20, Saveilon) with your support pairs: [[item:Azaga's Bow]]
detail: Also Large Bullion and an Antitoxin.
[[item:Azaga's Bow]] is cursed (Curse 2): hold it to the end of Part I (Drifting Reliquary).

explore.text: Spend any Turns still left on Inn Auto-Activities

battle.title: Qualifier vs. Silver Knights of Tellus

tips.text: Hold back and let the enemy advance
Scripted Bursts lower Theodora's max HP: keep her covered
